sources.name: WISE: A World Knowledge-Informed Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-Image Generation (arXiv v4)
sources.attribution: Yuwei Niu, Munan Ning, Mengren Zheng, Weiyang Jin, Bin Lin, Peng Jin, Jiaqi Liao, Chaoran Feng, Fanqing Meng, Kunpeng Ning, Bin Zhu, Li Yuan. WISE: A World Knowledge-Informed Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-Image Generation, arXiv:2503.07265v4 (2 Jun 2026), CC BY-SA 4.0. Extracted the Table 1 Overall WiScore for selected models; model labels mapped only to the stated checkpoint. No values estimated or rerun. Adapted rows must be shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. No endorsement.
sources.quote: arXiv abs page for 2503.07265v4 links "Rights to this article" to http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ (v1-v4 all CC BY-SA 4.0). The GitHub repo PKU-YuanGroup/WISE has no licence file and its leadboard.md is NOT used.
sources.scope: Only the benchmark authors' own Table 1 evaluation (Sec. 4.1: "We evaluate 20 T2I models ... we use the official default configurations of each model and fix the random seed"; judge GPT-4o-2024-05-13). Table 2 (rewritten prompts), appendix judge/weight/seed sensitivity tables and the Table 11 supplementary evaluation (judge not stated) are not used. ShareAlike: publish in the separate CC BY-SA tranche.

setup.version: WISE original 1,000 prompts (25 sub-domains), arXiv v4 Table 1
setup.metric: Published Overall WiScore (weighted average across Cultural, Time, Space, Biology, Physics, Chemistry); WiScore = (0.7 consistency + 0.2 realism + 0.1 aesthetics)/2, already on 0-1.
setup.protocol: Original (not rewritten) prompts; official default configuration per model with fixed seed; GPT-4o-2024-05-13 judge.
setup.comparability: Not the rewritten-prompt Table 2, not the WISE-Verified/Qwen-judge leaderboard in the repo, not the gemini-3.1-flash-lite sensitivity runs.
